content:
Context: 1-B. 'Workplace' includes:-

4. Complaint Mechanism.(i) An appropriate complaint mechanism should be created in every organization for redress of such complaints and time-bound treatment of the complaints should be ensured. Victims or witnesses should not be victimized or discriminated against while dealing with such cases. The report of the Complaints Committee shall be treated as an enquiry report. - GIDs (25) and (25-A to 25-D), Rule 3-C.
